verdict.rationale: Community threads (Hacker News) repeatedly compare DeepSeek to Claude, o1, Opus, GLM, and Kimi via informal benchmarks and hands-on testing, showing it is discussed and evaluated outside vendor channels, and even a distilled model's third-party benchmark results are cited. However, there is no evidence of DeepSeek appearing on formal, named independent leaderboards (e.g., LMSYS Arena, Artificial Analysis, HELM) with reproducible scores — the evidence is informal anecdotal comparisons rather than structured third-party benchmark rankings, and some commenters dispute that benchmark performance translates to real-world quality. Missing for 10: citations to formal third-party leaderboards/benchmark suites, independent quantitative scorecards, and resolution of the real-world-vs-benchmark discrepancy raised by users.
